board.content:
WHO WE ARE 

Artefact transforms data into value and business impact.

 

OUR MISSION

Everything we do focuses on capturing value from data.

Artefact is a global service company that sits at the intersection of marketing, consulting and data science.

Our 800 people break business and IT silos and transform organisations into consumer-centric leaders using digital, data and AI.

 

OUR VALUES

We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.

Our multi-disciplinary teams of experts — ‘Feature Teams’ as we call them — combine data consulting, data science and digital marketing into one comprehensive package.

This model breaks silos, supports innovation and produces stronger results.
Underpinning our skills are three core values. We believe in driving innovation, action and collaboration in everything we do.

 

OUR PEOPLE

Our Feature Teams are composed of multi-disciplinary data experts

 

 

Data Consultants

 

Our people are specialists in specific data solution fields and industry sectors. They combine data skills with wider business knowledge and are true experts in data consulting. They are not generalist consultan

 

 

Data Analysts and Data Scientists

Our data analysts and scientists are passionate about data, embrace complexity and love solving problems. They balance attention to details with speed of delivery and provide data expertise that ensures optimal management of client accounts.

 

Digital Marketing Experts

We have 300+ media experts with over 20 years of experience. Our people are skilled at SEO, PPC, Social, Programmatic, Display, Affiliates, CRM. We work with experienced creative directors, strategic planners and web designers. We have the latest Partner MarTech certifications, including Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Amazon and more.

 

Data & Software Engineer

With more than 100 engineers, Artefact has the largest team of software engineers in Europe. We recruit the best computer science and PhD graduates dedicated to data technology and analysis. Our people deliver deep consumer and performance insights and develop smart AI algorithms that do everything from demand predication analysis to customer segmentation.

jobs.content:
About Dubai Holding Group Services  
Dubai Holding Group Services is the shared-services arm of Dubai Holding, a globally diversified investment company that shapes Dubai's economy across real estate, hospitality, technology, and other key sectors. We are committed to operational excellence and fostering an environment that enables Dubai Holding's businesses to thrive for long-term impact.

About the Job:  
As a Junior Backend Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining scalable backend systems that support our diverse business needs.

The main duties and responsibilities include:  
- Develop and implement backend solutions to enhance system performance.  
- Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements.  
- Assist in database design and optimization for efficient data retrieval.  
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in accordance with standards.  
- Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and best practices.  
- Troubleshoot and debug applications to improve functionality.  
- Contribute to the documentation of systems and processes.  
- Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.  

About you:  
Essential:  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.  
- Proven experience in backend development using relevant technologies.  
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.  
- Understanding of database management systems and SQL.  
Desired:  
- Experience with cloud services and deployment strategies.  
- Knowledge of containerization tools like Docker or Kubernetes.  

About the Benefits:  
At Dubai Holding Group Services, we believe in nurturing talent and providing growth opportunities within an international, diverse team. Our inclusive workplace values every individual, ensuring a discrimination-free environment that encourages innovation and collaboration.<p><strong>Apply here:</strong> <a href="https://rh-agent.api.sofiatechnology.ai/jobs/junior-backend-engineer">https://rh-agent.api.sofiatechnology.ai/jobs/junior-backend-engineer</a></p>
